patthana22.34:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ no kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana22.34:2.1: hetuyā tīṇi. nasanidassanattika nadassanenapahātabbaduke sanidassanattika dassanenapahātabbadukaṃ na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā anidassanaappaṭigho dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
